mission.name: Megillah Services Representative
mission.problem: Users need a dependable way to complete the Megillah Services Representative workflow without unsafe or confusing failures
mission.context: This mission exercises the existing Megillah Services Representative product architecture while preserving current project conventions and evidence requirements
constraints: Preserve existing architecture and public contracts unless an explicit authority decision permits change
success_metrics: Every declared milestone acceptance scenario passes against the exact integrated candidate SHA

personas.context: Works in the product under realistic permissions and normal operating constraints
